# Pull request template

## Description

- What changed? (1-2 sentences)
- Why is it needed? (the problem it fixes or improves)

## How it was tested

Commands run and results, e.g.:

```powershell
cd backend
python -m pytest -q
```

## Anything worth calling out

(edge cases, follow-ups, screenshots/notes, files to review first)

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests pass (`python -m pytest -q` in `backend`)
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies without a note in this description
